exam.name: SCOR
exam.title: Implementing and Operating Cisco Security Core Technologies v2.0

objectives.text: Explain attack threats against on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments such as viruses, trojans, DoS/DDoS, phishing, rootkits, man-in-the middle, malware, data breaches, insecure APIs, compromised credentials, PQC, and AI

Describe security vulnerabilities and exploits such as software bugs, weak and/or hardcoded passwords, OWASP top ten, missing encryption ciphers, buffer overflow, path traversal, cross-site scripting/forgery, SQL injection, and identification and prioritization using CVEs and CVSS scores
Describe vulnerabilities in AI/LLM models such as prompt injection, system prompt leakage, vector and embedding weaknesses, and supply chain
Describe the controls used to protect against phishing and social engineering attacks

Describe cryptography security components such as hashing, encryption, PKI, SSL, TLS, QUIC, MASQUE, IPsec, NAT-T IPv4 for IPsec, preshared key, certificate-based authorization, and post-quantum cryptography
Describe site-to-site and remote access VPN deployment types such as virtual tunnel interfaces, standards-based IPsec, SSL VPN, DMVPN, FlexVPN, and GETVPN
Describe security intelligence authoring, sharing, and consumption
Describe zero trust architecture
Describe defense in depth strategy such as Secure Architecture for Everyone (SAFE)
Interpret scripts used to call security appliances APIs in a language such as Python
Describe network security solutions and deployment models that provide intrusion prevention and firewall capabilities
Describe security monitoring and telemetry technologies

Configure network infrastructure security methods (network segmentation using VLANs or SGTs; Layer 2 and port security; DHCP snooping; Dynamic ARP inspection; storm control; and defenses against MAC, ARP, VLAN hopping, STP, and DHCP rogue attacks)
Select management options for network security solutions (single vs. multidevice manager, in-band vs. out-of-band, on-premises vs. cloud with Cisco Security Cloud Control)
Describe CIS benchmarks for hardening devices such as Cisco Secure Firewall (FTD) and Cisco IOS XE
Troubleshoot AAA for device and network access such as TACACS+ and RADIUS
Configure secure network management of perimeter security and infrastructure devices such as SNMPv3, NetConf, RestConf, APIs, secure syslog, and NTP with authentication
Implement access control policies, AVC, URL filtering, malware protection, and intrusion prevention using Cisco Secure Firewall (FTD)
Configure site-to-site and remote access VPN using Cisco Secure Firewall (FTD) and Cisco Secure Client
Troubleshoot VPN tunnel establishment on Cisco Secure Firewall (FTD)
Describe security responsibility within common Cloud Shared Responsibility Models
Select security capabilities, deployment models, cloud security frameworks, and policy management to secure the cloud
Select security solutions for cloud environments (public; private; hybrid; community cloud; NIST 800-145 SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS; and Cloud Access Security Broker)
Describe network, application, and data security in cloud environments with solutions such as Cisco Multicloud Defense and Cisco Secure Workload
Configure Splunk to ingest cloud logging and monitoring data from other security solutions
Describe application and workload security concepts including eBPF
Describe DevSecOps (Infrastructure as Code security, CI/CD pipeline, container orchestration, and secure software development)
Describe Security Service Edge (SSE) and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
Configure Cisco Secure Access Secure Internet Access
Configure Cisco Secure Access Secure Private Access
Configure data loss prevention and AI guardrails for secure internet access
Interpret Cisco Secure Access Investigate scores and indicators
Describe Endpoint Protection Platforms (EPP) and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions
Describe endpoint device management and asset inventory systems such as MDM
Describe endpoint posture assessment solutions to ensure endpoint security
Describe endpoint protection and detection security with solutions such as Cisco Secure Client and Cisco Secure Malware Analytics
Configure endpoint antimalware protection using Cisco Secure Endpoint
Interpret Cisco Secure Endpoint malware detection events
Configure email security features with Cisco Security Email Threat Defense
Describe identity management and secure network access concepts such as guest services, profiling, posture assessment, and BYOD
Describe device compliance and application control
Configure network access control mechanisms such as 802.1X and MAB with Cisco Identity Services Engine
Configure network access with CoA
Explain exfiltration techniques such as DNS tunneling, HTTPS, email, FTP/SSH/SCP/SFTP, ICMP, Messenger, IRC, NTP, and cloud storage
Describe network visibility and enforcement using telemetry and native AI/ML capabilities with XDR and SIEM/SOAR platforms such as Splunk and Cisco XDR
Describe Cisco Duo in a zero-trust security architecture (Trust Monitor, MFA, Device Trust, health checks, Adaptive Access policies, SSO, and CII)
Describe managing, orchestrating, and automating security information and events with Splunk

lectures.title: Network Security: Firewalls, IPS, and Visibility
lectures.seo_title: SCOR 350-701 Network Security Notes: Firewall, IPS & Telemetry
lectures.description: Free CCNP Security notes for SCOR 350-701 v2.0 topics 2.1 and 2.2: firewall and IPS deployment models, FTD modes, NetFlow, SNMPv3 and telemetry.
lectures.dek: What enforces, where it goes, and how you see what got past it: firewall and IPS solutions and deployment models (2.1) and security monitoring and telemetry (2.2).
